question.text: Per the current NISM II-A workbook (p.193) on SEBI LODR disclosure, within how many minutes of the closure of a Board meeting must listed entities disclose material events or information to the stock exchange (with the additional after-hours qualification)?

answer.text: Within 30 minutes of closure of the Board meeting, with a 3-hour rule for certain after-hours closures

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 193 of the current NISM II-A workbook states that listed entities must disclose material events or information no later than 30 minutes from closure of the Board meeting, with a 3-hour rule applying to certain after-hours closures. The legacy 15-minute timeline is no longer the current rule. The Trap: 15 minutes is the legacy figure and the most common distractor. 60 and 120 minutes are not the prescribed disclosure windows. Cross-Exam Context: NISM II-A and III-A test LODR disclosure timelines, including the 2-working-day advance intimation for certain Board meetings and the broader event-disclosure framework.
